statement: A commercial email must include a clear and conspicuous identification that it is an advertisement or solicitation, a conspicuous opt-out notice with a functioning return address or Internet-based opt-out mechanism, and a valid physical postal address, and the sender must stop sending within 10 business days of an opt-out request (15 U.S.C. § 7704(a)(3)(A), (a)(4)(A)(i), (a)(5)(A)).
caveat: The advertisement label is not required where the recipient gave prior affirmative consent; transactional and relationship messages are treated separately. State laws and ESP policies add stricter rules. This repo does not classify specific messages.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (law-map 2026-10-14); independent domain expert review pending
